unit: RK-CACHE-001 evidence-free worker summary cache, bounded detail state, and stale response rejection
canonicalFlow: canonical seven-field RankingPolicyConditions including selfBuffs and conditionalEffects
rankingConditionsFingerprint serializes the ordered typed identity
worker context owns one successful summary value: rows and typed exclusions only
detail request validates current context, summary fingerprint, and entry before materializing
React applies a response only when request ID, fingerprint, and entry ID are all current
Ranking close clears the active detail and the next row replaces it

summary.lifetime: latest successful fingerprint in the current worker context

workerDetail.value: none; detail is materialized per request

reactActiveDetail.lifetime: close, row replacement, condition change, or context change

staleRejection.worker: detail lookup rejects non-current summary fingerprint and context before materialization
staleRejection.react: summary and detail responses require current worker instance/context plus request ID and fingerprint; detail also requires entry ID
staleRejection.afterClose: pending identity is cleared and a later response cannot populate detail state

typedOutcomeBoundary.fallback: none; cache and response handling do not coerce typed outcomes to numeric values

applicationBoundary.workerDetailAreaSupport: false, matching the existing summary calculation boundary and preserving production detail output
applicationBoundary.legacyRuntime: no old reader, operation-ID projection, compatibility flag, fallback, or parallel compiler added

directConsumers.reusedProductionEvidence: TSK-06.5 candidate inventory, support status, output digest, and parity remain unchanged

playwright.coverage: real worker summary/detail, desktop detail snapshot, keyboard contribution filter, 390px/320px overflow, calculator handoff
